purpose: Visual pest localization and annotated-box counting in still photographs
model: YOLO11 nano with official pretrained weights; 30 source category IDs kept distinct
source_license: CC BY-NC 4.0; noncommercial research use. Check original redistribution conditions.

validation_count_metrics.limitation: Counts are boxes detected against annotated boxes, not real-world pest census

preprocessing: COCO bbox normalized to YOLO xywh using source image sizes, no manual label merging
split_policy: Source train/val assignments preserved; V3 eligible subset excludes >2% aspect mismatch images and linked annotations; exact cross-split SHA256 checked
known_limitations: Validation may not represent unseen farms, sensors, or growing seasons
Source includes field, web, and lab imagery; domain shift
Class names duplicated by source ID; ambiguous species identity
300 unsafe aspect-ratio images (per V2 log) are excluded, not corrected; check current audit for exact counts
Inference confidence is not a calibrated probability
Not a crop disease diagnosis or whole-field pest census
